title: All Church Fellowship Dinner
seo_title: All Church Fellowship Dinner in Joplin, MO – Nov 22
description: This is a free fellowship dinner at Central Christian Center celebrating Thanksgiving and family, with Pastor Chris making Chicken Fried Rice for the main course. It is for the whole congregation; guests are asked to bring a dessert or side dish, and there will be cake for Pastor Hank's birthday, so feel free to bring a card. It takes place on November 22, 2026 (time TBD) at 410 S Virginia Ave in Joplin, MO.
address: 410 S Virginia Ave,Joplin, Missouri, Joplin, MO
